props.name: resource
props.comment: The jobs resource. Defaults to the resource context; with neither, nothing renders.

props.name: pollInterval
props.comment: Milliseconds between reads. Default 5000, `0` turns polling off.

props.name: tabs
props.comment: The statuses to show, one tab each and in this order. A job whose status has no tab is not shown.

props.name: statusSource
props.comment: Record field holding the job status, a top-level key. Default `"status"`.

props.name: typeSource
props.comment: The field shown as the job's type. Default `"type"`.

props.name: payloadSource
props.comment: The field holding the payload. Default `"payload"`.

props.name: errorSource
props.comment: The field holding the last error. Default `"lastError"`.

props.name: attemptsSource
props.comment: The field holding the attempt count. Default `"attempts"`.

props.name: createdAtSource
props.comment: The field holding the creation time. Default `"createdAt"`.

props.name: actions
props.comment: Show Retry and Cancel where the job allows them and the user has `edit` access. Default true.

props.name: retryFrom
props.comment: Statuses a job can be retried from. Default `["failed"]`.

props.name: cancelFrom
props.comment: Statuses a job can be cancelled from. Default `["running", "queued"]`.
